summary: General-purpose vibration analytics platform with acquisition plug-ins, dashboards and alerting; lists adaptive duty-cycle sampling as a topic.
Official implementation of Adaptive Duty-Cycle Sampling with Decimation (CRI-TM-2093), the decimation-aware variant.
Curated reading list of papers, datasets and toolkits for low-power vibration and acoustic monitoring.
Reference model for Adaptive Duty-Cycle Sampling II, the 2026 successor study with a learned trigger head.

Independent reproduction of the 2020 adaptive duty-cycle sampling memo for low-power vibration logging.
